# Pincer Ops — Full Documentation for LLMs

> GitOps-driven Kubernetes platform for deploying and operating OpenClaw — an open-source, self-hosted AI agent runtime.

## What is Pincer Ops?

Pincer Ops is a monorepo containing all declarative Kubernetes infrastructure manifests, ArgoCD Application definitions, bootstrap scripts, tests, and developer tooling needed to run OpenClaw on a local KIND cluster with production-fidelity networking. It is the single source of truth for cluster state.

OpenClaw is an open-source, self-hosted AI agent runtime that supports 14+ LLM platforms, AI skills/tools, and privacy-first operation. Pincer Ops provides the infrastructure to deploy and operate it.

## Architecture

The platform runs on KIND (Kubernetes in Docker) for local development:

```
KIND multi-node (1 control-plane + 2 workers)
  -> MetalLB L2 (LoadBalancer IP allocation)
    -> Envoy Gateway (Gateway API via DaemonSet + hostPort)
      -> ArgoCD (App of Apps pattern, self-managing)
        -> OpenClaw Gateway (StatefulSet, single replica, PVC-backed)
```

### Sync Wave Ordering

Infrastructure deploys before workloads via ArgoCD sync waves:

| Wave | Component              | Purpose                                           |
|------|------------------------|---------------------------------------------------|
| -10  | ArgoCD + AppProjects   | Must exist before managing anything else           |
| -5   | MetalLB                | LoadBalancer IPs needed by Gateway                 |
| -4   | Envoy Gateway          | Gateway API CRDs and controller (OCI Helm)         |
| -3   | Sealed Secrets         | Controller must exist before SealedSecrets decrypt |
| -2   | cert-manager           | TLS certificate infrastructure                     |
| -1   | Envoy Gateway config   | Gateway + HTTPRoute resources (needs CRDs from -4) |
| +10  | OpenClaw Gateway       | Depends on all infrastructure                      |

### Core Invariant

`kubectl apply -f bootstrap/root-app.yaml` must reconstruct the complete cluster state. Every resource is either the root Application or discoverable by it through recursive directory scanning.

## Repository Structure

```
pincer-ops/
├── Makefile                    # Developer workflow (make help)
├── bootstrap/
│   ├── root-app.yaml           # THE singular entry point
│   ├── argocd-self.yaml        # ArgoCD self-management (wave -10)
│   ├── infra-metallb.yaml      # MetalLB (wave -5)
│   ├── infra-envoy-gateway.yaml        # Envoy Gateway controller (wave -4, OCI Helm)
│   ├── infra-envoy-gateway-config.yaml # Envoy Gateway config (wave -1)
│   ├── infra-sealed-secrets.yaml       # Sealed Secrets (wave -3)
│   ├── infra-cert-manager.yaml         # cert-manager (wave -2)
│   ├── workload-openclaw.yaml          # OpenClaw (wave +10)
│   └── projects/
│       ├── infrastructure.yaml # AppProject: all namespaces
│       └── workloads.yaml      # AppProject: openclaw namespace only
├── infrastructure/
│   ├── metallb/base/           # Remote kustomize: MetalLB v0.15.3
│   ├── envoy-gateway/base/     # EnvoyProxy DaemonSet, GatewayClass, Gateway
│   ├── sealed-secrets/base/    # Remote kustomize: Sealed Secrets v0.35.0
│   └── cert-manager/base/      # Remote kustomize: cert-manager v1.19.2
├── workloads/
│   └── openclaw/
│       ├── base/               # StatefulSet, Service, ConfigMap, HTTPRoute, NetworkPolicy
│       └── overlays/dev/       # Image tag pinning
├── cluster/
│   └── kind-config.yaml        # 3-node KIND cluster config
├── scripts/
│   ├── bootstrap.sh            # Full cluster creation + ArgoCD bootstrap (16 steps)
│   ├── teardown.sh             # Destroy KIND cluster
│   ├── setup-repo.sh           # Configure ArgoCD repoURL for forks
│   ├── setup-mcp.sh            # Generate ArgoCD API token for MCP
│   ├── validate-manifests.sh   # kubeconform validation
│   └── lib/common.sh           # Shared helpers
└── tests/                      # 87 unit + 10 integration tests (BATS)
```

## Quick Start

### Prerequisites

- Docker Desktop (or compatible runtime)
- kind (Kubernetes in Docker)
- kubectl

### Commands

```bash
# Clone and bootstrap
git clone https://github.com/PatrykQuantumNomad/pincer-ops.git
cd pincer-ops
make up          # Creates KIND cluster + deploys full stack (~3 min)
make status      # All apps should show Synced / Healthy

# Access OpenClaw
make openclaw-onboard    # Configure AI agent runtime
# Open http://localhost in your browser

# Other operations
make down        # Destroy cluster
make reset       # Full teardown + rebuild
make sync        # Sync all ArgoCD apps
make logs        # Tail OpenClaw logs
make validate    # Validate manifests (kubeconform)
make test        # Run all 97 BATS tests
```

### For Forks

If you fork the repo, run `make setup-repo` after cloning to update ArgoCD manifests to sync from your fork instead of the upstream repository.

## OpenClaw Details

- Image: ghcr.io/openclaw/openclaw:{version}
- Command: `node dist/index.js gateway --bind lan --port 18789`
- Port 18789: Gateway HTTP (Control UI, WebChat, API)
- Data directory: /home/node/.openclaw/ (PVC-backed, 20Gi)
- Config: openclaw.json seeded from ConfigMap, then managed by UI on PVC
- Health check: httpGet /health on port 18789
- Cannot scale horizontally — always replicas: 1, always StatefulSet
- Gateway token and LLM provider keys configured post-deployment via make openclaw-onboard

## Infrastructure Components

### MetalLB (v0.15.3)
Layer 2 load balancer for KIND. Allocates LoadBalancer IPs from the KIND Docker network CIDR (dynamically computed at bootstrap time). Required because KIND doesn't natively support LoadBalancer services.

### Envoy Gateway (Gateway API)
Runs as a DaemonSet with hostPort binding on the control-plane node (nodeSelector ingress-ready: "true"). Provides Gateway API routing (HTTPRoute) for localhost access on macOS/KIND. The only viable path for localhost:80/443 access on macOS.

### ArgoCD
GitOps continuous delivery using App of Apps pattern. Self-managing (argocd-self.yaml). Resource tracking via annotation+label. Includes Lua health check for Application health assessment (required for sync wave ordering).

### Sealed Secrets (v0.35.0)
Bitnami Sealed Secrets for encrypted secret management. Controller runs in kube-system. Sealing key backup/restore via scripts/lib/sealed-secrets.sh. Daily backup CronJob at 03:00.

### cert-manager (v1.19.2)
TLS certificate infrastructure with self-signed ClusterIssuer for dev environments.

## Conventions

- All manifests use explicit API versions
- Every workload has resource requests AND limits
- Every long-running workload has liveness and readiness probes
- Image tags are explicit versions (never :latest)
- All secrets are SealedSecrets (never plaintext)
- Naming: infra-{component} for infrastructure, workload-{component} for workloads
- Pre-commit hook rejects plaintext kind: Secret

## Key Facts

- License: MIT
- Language: Bash + YAML (no application source code, no Dockerfiles)
- Tests: 97 BATS tests (87 unit + 10 integration)
- CI: GitHub Actions with kubeconform validation on PRs to main
- Namespaces: argocd, metallb-system, envoy-gateway-system, kube-system, cert-manager, openclaw
- KIND cluster name: openclaw-dev
- Topology: 1 control-plane + 2 workers

## OpenClaw Internal Architecture

An interactive architecture explorer is available at https://pincer.patrykgolabek.dev/openclaw-architecture covering:

- **Architecture layers**: Gateway API, Agent Runtime, Memory & Storage, Skill Engine, Tool Execution, LLM Providers
- **Data flow**: Inbound request pipeline (HTTP/WebSocket intake, auth, session hydration, intent classification) through the Tool Execution Loop (LLM planning, skill dispatch, sandboxed execution, result aggregation) to outbound response (streaming assembly, format negotiation, delivery)
- **Core modules**: Gateway, AgentManager, SkillEngine, ToolRunner, MemoryStore, LLMRouter, ConfigManager, PluginLoader
- **Extension system**: Custom skills, LLM provider adapters, storage backends, middleware hooks, UI themes
- **Tech stack**: Node.js/TypeScript runtime, SQLite + vector DB storage, REST/WebSocket/SSE transport, Docker packaging
- **Contributor guide**: Setup, conventions, testing, and PR workflow

Source: OpenClaw repository at https://github.com/OpenClaw/OpenClaw (13,900+ commits, MIT licensed)
